description: Global catalog of atmospheric rivers (ARs) with co-located precipitation extremes, based on the global PIKART (PIK Atmospheric River Trajectories V1.1) catalog. It is from ERA5 reanalysis (1940–2024) at 0.5° spatial resolution and 6-hourly temporal resolution. At each grid cell, we provide the binary AR mask, integrated water vapor transport (IVT), AR event duration, AR event intensity and AR rank. Additionally, we integrated ERA5 precipitation with the same spatiotemporal resolution as the PIKART catalog. Precipitation is provided through a total of four variables, i.e., total precipitation and three binary extreme precipitation event masks (with respect to the 90th, 95th and 99th percentiles as thresholds). IVT is computed by integrating the product of specific humidity and wind components from 300 hPa to 1000 hPa. Companion to Vallejo-Bernal & Braun et al. (2025), JGR Atmospheres. A comprehensive description is provided in the paper and via https://ar.pik-potsdam.de/.

cf:parameter.name: ar_mask
cf:parameter.long_name: Binary indicator equal to 1 for atmospheric river conditions present at a grid cell and 0 for their absence

cf:parameter.name: duration
cf:parameter.long_name: Duration of uninterrupted atmospheric river conditions (AR event)

cf:parameter.name: intensity
cf:parameter.long_name: Maximum vertically integrated water vapor transport during uninterrupted atmospheric river conditions (AR event)

cf:parameter.name: ivt
cf:parameter.long_name: Magnitude of the vertically integrated water vapor transport during atmospheric river conditions

cf:parameter.name: epe_p90
cf:parameter.description: Binary indicator (1=True, 0=False) of precipitation exceeding the 90th percentile of precipitation intensity (1940-2024 baseline).

cf:parameter.name: epe_p95
cf:parameter.description: Binary indicator (1=True, 0=False) of precipitation exceeding the 95th percentile of precipitation intensity (1940-2024 baseline).

cf:parameter.name: epe_p99
cf:parameter.description: Binary indicator (1=True, 0=False) of precipitation exceeding the 99th percentile of precipitation intensity (1940-2024 baseline).
